name: Conol (conol.ai)
description: Conol is a knowledge base powered by agents that research, run long jobs in the background, file results into your notes, and reach you when done. Passkey-only auth via better-auth; no email/password or social login.
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: Next.js Turbopack SPA on Vercel; better-auth v1.6.16 client + passkey + organization plugins; 22 JS bundles (~958 KB) covering marketing + auth; app code lazy-loaded behind session (no API surface reachable statically)

transport.protocol: better-auth cookie session on /api/auth/*; chat/agent wire unknown -- no SSE, WebSocket, or fetch ReadableStream signatures found in the static bundle set

auth.signInMethod: passkey (WebAuthn) only -- email/password, Google OAuth, OTP, magic-link all return 404

capabilities.name: Chat (UNVERIFIED)
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; streamed answer -- wire protocol, selectors, and streaming transport all unknown from static analysis (requires headed capture)
capabilities.method: ui-path (presumed -- composer + Enter; site's own send handler; exact selectors unverified)
capabilities.implementation: APP CODE IS LAZY-LOADED BEHIND AUTH. No chat/agent API endpoints or streaming transports found in the 22 static JS bundles. The SPA app renders client-side after session injection. All selectors, API paths, and streaming protocol must be captured from a live headed session.

auth.signInMethod: passkey (WebAuthn) only -- no email/password or social login
auth.note: Auth is passkey-only via better-auth. The passkey registration uses WebAuthn generateRegistrationOptions + verifyRegistrationOptions (browser-native prompt). After registration, authentication uses generateAuthenticationOptions + verifyAuthenticationOptions. Cookie is __Secure-better-auth.session_token (Secure prefix, HttpOnly). Session check: GET /api/auth/get-session returns null when unauthenticated. Admin plugin is present (/api/auth/admin/list-users returns 401 without bearer). Organization plugin is present but not probed.

permissions: requires a real logged-in Conol session (passkey-registered account)
passkey registration requires browser-native WebAuthn ceremony (cannot be scripted)
no anti-bot fingerprint SDK detected in static surface
analysisMethod: static curl + 22 JS bundles (~958 KB total) + live API probe against /api/auth/*; no browser launched; app code unreachable without auth
